section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Wipers and Washers
title: REPLACEMENT OF FRONT WIPER AND WASHER SWITCH
ocr_text:
REPLACEMENT OF FRONT WIPER AND
WASHER SWITCH

REPLACE WIPER AND WASHER SWITCH
(a) Remove the terminals from the connector.
(See page BE 2)
(b) Remove the wiper control switch and washer switch.
(c) Install the wiper control switch and washer switch.
(d) Connect the terminals to the connector.
(See pages BE 3 and 22)

Front Wiper and Washer Relay

terminal 12. Connect the negative (-) lead to ter-

follows.
